test_resample_basic: test the Series.resample method with closed and label parameters for downsampling time series data
test_resample_ohlc: test the resample ohlc method computes open, high, low, close values for grouped time intervals
test_resample_origin: test the resample method with origin and offset parameters for custom bin alignment
test_resample_with_nat: test the resample method handles NaT (Not a Time) values in DatetimeIndex correctly
test_resample_dst_anchor: test the resample method handles daylight saving time transitions correctly
test_custom_grouper: test the Grouper class with freq parameter for grouping Series by time intervals
test_resample_apply_functions: test the resample apply method with lambda and callable functions for custom aggregation
test_resample_nunique: test the resample nunique method counts distinct values per time bin
test_resample_aggregate_functions_min_co: test resample min/max/first/last with min_count parameter for NaN handling
test_resample_upsampling_picked_but_not_: test resample upsampling behavior when axis frequency matches resample frequency
